title: Columnar and diffuse topographies in the marmoset prefrontal connectome.
abstract: In this issue of Neuron, Watakabe et al.<sup>1</sup> utilize serial two-photon tomography to reveal that the intra- and inter-regional prefrontal cortex projections in the marmoset brain terminate with two characteristic patterns, columnar and diffused, both of which display a topographically organized gradient.
